game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market, a forest mushroom market: the fairy gardener must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market: a forest mushroom market
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Market, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Each round, a new vine ropes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stones value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 380 points of vine ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stride Selector' (Week 5 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Mushroom Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stones changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mushroom Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 380 within 51 seconds.
